Senses.Explanation: The lineage vehicle is the ancestral line's own teaching and public business. Unnamed monks repeatedly ask named masters about its highest rule or upward presentation; Huangbo Xiyun asks Baizhang Huaihai how it is shown, while Chengtian Zong comments on how difficult it is to support. The phrase marks lineage jurisdiction rather than a literal vehicle.
